Title: PlayToEarn.net
Full description: PlayToEarn.net is the most comprehensive Web3 game discovery platform, indexing over 3,000 blockchain games across every chain and genre. It provides reviews, ratings, news, earnings analysis and a blockchain game awards system. It is the go-to starting point for researching any new GameFi title before committing time or money.
What is it:
PlayToEarn is the IMDb of blockchain gaming: every game has a dedicated page with reviews, on-chain stats, earning potential estimates and community ratings. Before you download anything, you search here.

The filter system is its killer feature — you can narrow down 3,000+ games by blockchain, genre, earning model (free-to-play, play-to-earn, play-and-own), device, NFT requirements and current status (active, beta, upcoming). Instead of reading 10 articles, you run one filter and get a shortlist of games that actually fit your situation.
How it works:
1. Go to playtoearn.net and use the filter bar at the top.

  2. Select your chain (Ethereum, Ronin, BNB, Solana, etc.) and earning model (Free to Play is a safe start).

  3. Open individual game pages for reviews, tokenomics breakdown, earning potential estimates and community feedback.

  4. Check the 'Status' field — Active means live servers, Beta means early access, Upcoming means not launched yet.

  5. Read the Earnings section carefully — it shows typical monthly income ranges for casual vs. dedicated players.

PlayToEarn also runs the annual Blockchain Game Awards — a useful signal for identifying which games the community considers highest quality each year.
When to use it:
• Before starting any new Web3 game — research it here first, no exceptions.

  • To compare earning potential across multiple games before deciding where to invest your time.

  • For weekly news on game launches, token listings and ecosystem updates in the GameFi space.

  • As a due diligence tool before purchasing any NFT or in-game asset.

Rule: if a game doesn't have a PlayToEarn page with real community reviews, treat it as an unverified project until proven otherwise.

Title: The Sandbox
Referral Type: Bonus EP per ogni amico invitato durante le Alpha Season attive
Full description: The Sandbox is an Ethereum metaverse where anyone can play, build and earn SAND tokens. Its earning engine runs on Alpha Seasons — multi-week events held roughly once per quarter with 100+ curated experiences, a Battle Pass progression system, daily quests and massive SAND prize pools. Alpha Season 4 (Oct–Dec 2024) distributed $2.5M+ in SAND to 276,000 unique players. Season 5 ran on a Jurassic World theme in March 2025. Season 7 launched February 25, 2026 with $53,000 in SAND rewards. Between seasons the platform runs brand activations, Game Jams (up to 150,000 SAND in creator prizes) and Avatar Transformation Events.
What is it:
The Sandbox is not just a metaverse — it's a seasonal earn machine. The world exists 365 days a year, but the real earning windows are the Alpha Seasons: multi-week festivals where every day a new experience unlocks, daily quests give SAND, and the Battle Pass rewards every level-up with tokens and NFTs.

The brands that have built experiences here are not a coincidence: Snoop Dogg, Adidas, Atari, Attack on Titan, Gordon Ramsay, Jurassic World, Warner Music. Each brand activation brings its own limited NFT drops — collectibles you can only get by being there during that specific window. After the event ends, that NFT is gone. This is the scarcity mechanic that makes showing up on launch day genuinely valuable.
How it works:
1. Create a free account at sandbox.game and download the game client (Windows or Mac).

  2. Connect your MetaMask wallet — this is where SAND and NFT rewards land on-chain.

  3. Check the Events and Map tabs to find today's active experience — completing it first gives a bonus EP multiplier.

  4. Work through the Battle Pass: daily quests + social challenges + adventure quests each unlock SAND and NFT rewards.

  5. Target the weekly Alpha Pass raffle — 500 passes are given free each week to top leaderboard players. The pass multiplies all SAND earnings 13x.

  6. Between Alpha Seasons: check the Events calendar at sandbox.game for brand activations (standalone events with their own NFT and SAND pools), Avatar Transformation Events and creator competitions.

  7. For creators: enter monthly Game Jams with prize pools up to 150,000 SAND — open to any VoxEdit or Game Maker user.

  8. LAND holders: Seasons distribute additional SAND bonuses to LAND owners on top of regular player rewards.

Recurring earn calendar to bookmark: Alpha Seasons run ~once per quarter (10 weeks each). Game Jams run monthly. Brand activations are announced 1–2 weeks in advance on @TheSandboxGame on X. DAO governance votes (on a 25M SAND community budget) run continuously for SAND and LAND stakers.
When to use it:
• On Alpha Season launch day — the first week always has the highest participant-to-reward ratio before the competition builds.

  • During brand activations (Jurassic World, Snoop Dogg, etc.) for limited NFT drops — these wearables have a hard cutoff date after which they become secondary market only.

  • Every week for the Alpha Pass raffle — free entry, 500 passes, the upside is a 13x multiplier on all season earnings.

  • During Game Jams if you use VoxEdit or Game Maker — creator prize pools are some of the highest in Web3.

  • As a LAND holder during any Season — ownership passively multiplies your baseline SAND rewards.

Where to track events: sandbox.game/events (official calendar), @TheSandboxGame on X (launch alerts), The Sandbox Discord #announcements (real-time drops). Flagship events are announced 3–5 weeks ahead. Brand activations appear 1 week ahead. Game Jam deadlines are monthly.

Title: Decentraland
Description: Events for Free NFT wearable drops, MANA prizes
Referral Type: 500 MANA bonus for recommending an eligible community as a Music Festival Party Pad — paid if the community is selected
Full description: Decentraland is the original DAO-governed Ethereum metaverse, fully running since 2020. It operates a fixed annual event calendar with four flagship events: Music Festival (December, 4 days, $10K+ MANA prizes and live wearable drops during DJ sets), Art Week (September, 4 days, 27+ immersive artworks with interactive rewards), Metaverse Fashion Week (April, 4 days, $1,000 MANA Community Choice Award and designer grants), Career Quest (July, 2 days, $12,000 Web3 bootcamp scholarship pool). Community-organized events run daily across 50+ active districts. The guest mode requires zero wallet setup — the lowest entry barrier of any major metaverse.
What is it:
Decentraland is the only major metaverse where a completely new user can walk in with no wallet, no crypto and no money — and walk out with real blockchain assets the same day. The guest mode is genuinely open: connect at play.decentraland.org, choose an avatar, and you're inside. If you happen to be standing in front of the right stage at the Music Festival when a wearable drops, it goes directly into your wallet — if you have one connected.

The four flagship events are not marketing campaigns — they're the most consistent earn windows in the metaverse space. Music Festival has run annually since 2021 with live MANA prize pools. Metaverse Fashion Week launched careers of digital fashion designers who now sell wearables for thousands of dollars on OpenSea. Art Week brings 27+ curated artworks with creator-set interactive rewards. Career Quest hands out $12,000 in real scholarships for Web3 development bootcamps. These are real economic events, not virtual theater.
How it works:
1. Go to play.decentraland.org — click 'Jump in as Guest' to enter immediately without any setup.

  2. Open the Events tab inside Decentraland to see the live calendar — both official flagship events and community-organized daily happenings.

  3. Connect a MetaMask wallet if you want to actually own what you earn — guest mode lets you attend but not keep rewards on-chain.

  4. Music Festival (December): stand in front of the main stage during DJ sets — wearables drop live to nearby avatars. Arrive 5 minutes early, don't move.

  5. Art Week (September): follow the creator tour across 27 artworks — some include hidden interactive reward mechanisms, discoverable only by engaging with the installations.

  6. Metaverse Fashion Week (April): enter the Wearables Around the World contest by submitting a wearable design — shortlisted creators get their submission fee reimbursed plus compete for the $1,000 MANA Community Choice Award.

  7. Career Quest (July): complete in-world skill challenges to qualify for the $12,000 Web3 bootcamp scholarship pool.

  8. Between flagship events: visit decentraland.org/events daily — community organizers run game tournaments, photo contests, live music sessions, DAO AMAs and more, many with MANA or NFT prizes.

Earn calendar: Music Festival → December. Art Week → September. Metaverse Fashion Week → April. Career Quest → July. Daily community events → every day at decentraland.org/events. DAO governance → continuous, MANA and LAND stakers vote on platform decisions and grant distribution.
When to use it:
• During Music Festival (December) — wearable drops are the highest-value free reward in any metaverse. Zero cost, just show up at the right stage at the right time.

  • During Metaverse Fashion Week (April) for designers — the $1,000 prize and global exposure are the best return on creative work in Web3 fashion.

  • During Art Week (September) — interactive artworks with hidden rewards favor explorers who engage deeply rather than tourist-walking through.

  • During Career Quest (July) for anyone interested in Web3 development — $12,000 in scholarship value with no financial entry barrier.

  • Daily for community events — the active districts (Vegas City casino district, Museum District, Fashion District) each run recurring events with their own reward pools.

  • As a first metaverse experience for students or contacts — guest mode makes it the only major metaverse that requires zero crypto setup to attend.

Where to track events: decentraland.org/events (official calendar, filterable by date and district), @decentraland on X (flagship event announcements 4–6 weeks ahead), Decentraland Discord #events (community events, often 24-48h notice). Music Festival lineup is announced in November. Fashion Week brands are announced in March.

Title: Elixir Games
Description: 130+ blockchain games in one launcher, with launchpad.
Referral Type: Referral program with ELIX token rewards
Full description: Elixir Games is a desktop game launcher purpose-built for Web3 — the answer to Steam's ban on crypto games. It aggregates 130+ blockchain games in a unified client with auto-updates, anti-cheat, multi-OS support, an NFT marketplace and an integrated launchpad for new game launches. It uses ELIX as its ecosystem token.
What is it:
Elixir is what Steam would look like if it had been built in 2024 instead of 2003: all your Web3 games in one library, auto-updated, with an integrated marketplace to buy and sell in-game NFTs without leaving the app. Steam banned blockchain games — Elixir built the replacement.

The launchpad is the highest-value feature for serious GameFi players: new games that launch through Elixir offer early NFT mints, whitelist spots and beta access exclusively to launcher users. Getting in early on a game before the public launch has historically meant the difference between buying NFTs at mint price and buying them 5x higher after the game goes viral.
How it works:
1. Download the Elixir launcher from elixir.games — available for Windows, Mac and Linux.

  2. Create an account and connect your Web3 wallet.

  3. Browse the game library — filter by genre, chain or play model.

  4. Install games directly from the launcher — auto-updates keep everything current without manual downloads.

  5. Check the Launchpad section for upcoming game launches with early NFT access and whitelist opportunities.

  6. Use the integrated NFT store to buy and sell in-game assets across all supported games.

Elixir also has a built-in quest system where completing in-game challenges earns ELIX tokens redeemable for game assets or sold on exchange.
When to use it:
• As your primary desktop client for any Web3 PC game — it replaces going to individual game websites.

  • For early access to new game launches through the launchpad — whitelist spots fill quickly.

  • To manage your Web3 game NFT portfolio in one place without juggling multiple marketplaces.

  • If you want to earn ELIX passively by completing quest challenges across multiple games.

Elixir is the infrastructure layer for serious Web3 gaming on PC. Install it once and you have a permanent home base for your gaming activity.

Title: HyperPlay
Description: Web3 launcher that merges your Steam, Epic and GOG library
Referral Type: Referral program for new user signups
Full description: HyperPlay is an open-source game store and launcher developed by Game7 (backed by MetaMask/ConsenSys). It aggregates Web3 games and connects them with existing Web2 libraries from Steam, Epic Games Store and GOG — the only launcher that bridges both worlds. It supports multiple wallets and aims to be chain-agnostic.
What is it:
HyperPlay solved the biggest friction point in Web3 gaming adoption: gamers don't want to abandon the 500-game Steam library they built over 15 years just to play blockchain games. HyperPlay puts everything in one client — your Steam games sit next to your Web3 games, your MetaMask wallet is always connected, and you switch between them without relaunching anything.

As the only MetaMask-native launcher, HyperPlay handles wallet connections automatically. No more approving transactions in a separate browser window — the wallet popup appears inside the launcher itself. It's the smoothest Web3 gaming UX available for desktop users coming from a traditional gaming background.
How it works:
1. Download HyperPlay from store.hyperplay.xyz — open source, verifiable.

  2. Connect your MetaMask (or other compatible) wallet during setup.

  3. Import your existing Steam, Epic or GOG library — your Web2 games appear alongside Web3 titles.

  4. Browse the Web3 game catalog and install directly from the launcher.

  5. Wallet interactions (transaction approvals, NFT mints) appear as native popups inside the launcher.

HyperPlay also features an achievement system that rewards players with onchain credentials for completing game milestones.
When to use it:
• If you're a traditional PC gamer transitioning to Web3 — keep your existing library and add blockchain games alongside.

  • For MetaMask users who want seamless wallet integration without browser switching.

  • As a Web3 Steam alternative that doesn't force you to choose between legacy and blockchain gaming.

  • For developers building Web3 games who want distribution on an open, chain-agnostic platform.

Title: SolGames
Description: Real-time discovery and ranking Solana games
Full description: SolGames.buzz is a discovery and analytics platform focused exclusively on Solana blockchain games. AI agents continuously scan X and on-chain data for early signals of new game launches, then verify each candidate by checking for a real playable client, confirming it runs on Solana, and profiling the token and team. Verified games are tagged as "Scouted," "Analyzed," or "Verified" depending on how much data has been confirmed, and ranked by a live "Buzz" score that measures real social momentum alongside price, market cap and player count. The platform launched in June 2026 and is still an early-stage project with a small social following.
What is it: SolGames.buzz works like a live radar for the Solana gaming sector: instead of reading scattered announcements across X, you get one dashboard listing every tracked game with its token price, 24h change, market cap, holder count and live player numbers where available. Each listed game carries a status label — Scouted (just flagged, unverified), Analyzed (checked by an AI agent), or Verified (fully confirmed) — so you can immediately see how much due diligence has been done before you go looking at a project yourself.
How it works:
1. Go to solgames.buzz/discover and browse the list of tracked Solana games, filterable by Trending, Popular, Most Played, Top Gainers or New.

  2. Check each game's status badge (Scouted / Analyzed / Verified) to gauge how much verification has been done.

  3. Open a game's page to see its token price, market cap, 24h change, holder count and live player count where available.

  4. Visit the Rankings page for a leaderboard sorted by market cap, volume and Buzz score.

  5. Check the Feed page for a chronological stream of game launches, milestones and partnerships across the Solana gaming ecosystem.

  6. Read the Reviews section for written breakdowns of individual games, including delisted or failed projects kept as reference.

  7. Optionally, connect a wallet on the Community page to submit a game that isn't tracked yet — if the team's AI agent confirms it, the submitting wallet gets a "Hunter" credit on the game's page.
When to use it:
• Before trying a new Solana game, to check whether it has a verified client and an active token.

  • To compare market cap, price movement and player counts across multiple Solana games in one place.

  • To follow real-time news on new launches and partnerships in the Solana gaming space via the Feed.

  • As a reference before buying a game token, given the platform also documents delisted or collapsed projects.

Note: the platform itself is early-stage (live since June 2026), so treat its own coverage as one data point rather than a final verdict on any game.

Title: WEMIX PLAY
Description: 100+ blockchain games with built-in swap, WEMIX$
Full description: WEMIX PLAY is the blockchain gaming platform developed by Wemade, the Korean studio behind The Legend of Mir franchise with 500M+ lifetime users. It hosts 100+ blockchain games with integrated DeFi services: a token swap for game tokens, staking, NFT auctions, and the WEMIX$ stablecoin. It is the dominant GameFi platform in the Asian market.
What is it:
WEMIX PLAY is what GameFi looks like when built by a 25-year veteran game studio instead of a DeFi team that decided to make games. Wemade shipped The Legend of Mir — one of the most played MMORPGs in Asia — before blockchain existed. WEMIX PLAY is their answer to what gaming + crypto should look like when the gaming side actually knows what it's doing.

The key differentiator is the integrated financial layer: you earn tokens in a game, swap them to WEMIX$ (a stablecoin) inside the same platform without touching an external exchange, then stake them for yield — all without leaving WEMIX PLAY. It's a closed-loop economy where game earnings have a direct path to stable value, which most GameFi platforms still can't offer.
How it works:
1. Create a WEMIX account at wemixplay.com and connect a compatible wallet.

  2. Browse the game catalog — filter by genre, platform (PC/mobile) or earning model.

  3. Each game has its own token economy — check the tokenomics page before starting.

  4. Earn game-specific tokens through gameplay.

  5. Use the WEMIX PLAY integrated swap to convert game tokens to pWEMIX$ stablecoin.

  6. Stake tokens in the DeFi section to earn passive yield on your gaming earnings.

WEMIX PLAY also runs regular NFT auctions and REFLECT token mechanics — synthetic tokens created by fusing multiple game tokens that appreciate as the ecosystem grows.
When to use it:
• If you want a full-ecosystem approach to GameFi — earn, swap, stake all in one platform without external exchanges.

  • For mobile-first GameFi gaming — WEMIX has a strong catalog of mobile titles.

  • To access the Asian GameFi market and games not available on Western-focused platforms.

  • For the WEMIX$ stablecoin path — one of the few GameFi platforms where you can stabilize earnings without leaving the ecosystem.

WEMIX is the most mature full-stack GameFi ecosystem from a company with actual gaming pedigree. If sustainable tokenomics matter to you, this is worth investigating seriously.
